text:
maria_g: Heads-up: Orchid Logistics invoice #98765 didn't PO-match. The vendor code on the PDF is 'ORCH-LGC' but our PO 45000123 is tied to 'ORCH-LOG'. Routing went to AP-ops, not Procurement. PDF: https://invoices.redwood.internal/98765.pdf

alex_k: Got it. Can we remap the vendor code in Coupa and requeue? If the vendor master change is small I can do it today.

maria_g: Please. Also invoice hit GL 5602 (consulting) but should be GL 5420 (cloud hosting) — month-end is tomorrow so need allocation corrected when reprocessing.

finance-bot: Invoice 98765: PO mismatch detected. Suggested workflow: create vendor-code remap ticket -> reprocess invoice -> update GL account -> route to Procurement approvers. Suggested ticket: INV-4512.

liam_p: Quick check: vendor TAX ID on the invoice is 12-3456789, remit details unchanged. If Alex does remap, ensure vendor record update keeps the same remit. Procurement approver list should pull from vendor master after remap.

alex_k: Opening ticket now. INV-4512 created: Remap ORCH-LGC -> ORCH-LOG + set primary GL for PO 45000123 to 5420 on reprocess. Marking urgent for EOD.

procurement-bot: Notification: Vendor master change request INV-4512 submitted to Procurement queue. Status: pending-approval. Approver group: procurement-team@redwood.com.

maria_g: Thanks. If procurement auto-lookup still returns empty after remap, I'll approve manually to avoid missing the cutoff.

alex_k: Understood. I'll post back once remap is complete and invoice is requeued. If anything blocks approval routing I'll escalate to @maria_g and @liam_p.

finance-bot: Update scheduled: vendor remap -> reprocess invoice -> set GL 5420 -> route to procurement-team. ETA: today EOD. Will post results.

liam_p: One more item: vendor changed name this quarter, so watch for historical invoices tied to ORCH-LOG. I'll add a note to INV-4512 to backfill mapping for prior invoices.

alex_k: Backfill note added. Also added a one-off manual approval path if procurement system returns no approvers during reprocess.

maria_g: Appreciate it. Please confirm when the invoice finally routes to procurement so I can close the invoice hold.

finance-bot: INV-4512 status: in-progress. Next automated ping in 2 hours.
